hooks.command: cmd="$(jq -r '.tool_input.command')"; first_line="$(printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | head -n1)"; if printf '%s' "$first_line" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*(grep|egrep|fgrep|rg|ack|ag)\b'; then jq -n --arg reason 'This project has a pcs MCP project registered ("MCP Project server local"). Use mcp__pcs__search_code / retrieve_context / get_code_map for code search instead of grep/rg (see CLAUDE.md pcs-first rule) -- it also finds semantic matches grep cannot. If this really is not a source-code search (filtering log/command output, git history, etc.), pipe it through that other command first so grep/rg is not the first thing in the pipeline.' '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:$reason}}'; fi
